sourceEvidence.label: Foldry archive, filesystem, persistence, and desktop trust boundaries

assessment.summary: The reviewed controls already converge on owned scanner, executor, output, and IPC boundaries. Two execution-boundary trust assumptions were hardened locally; the evidence does not justify a new service or process boundary for v1.

nonNegotiables: Never follow a source link while reading a planned regular file.
Never publish a partial archive over a working archive.
Do not grant the webview ambient filesystem or opener authority.
Do not transmit source paths or telemetry over the network.
assumptions: The operating-system user who owns the Foldry configuration and output directory is trusted.
No process isolation or encrypted local history is required for v1.
No measured release performance budget was supplied; balanced local thresholds are recorded in docs/performance.md.

localRemediations.title: Bind manifest entries to the selected source root
localRemediations.change: The executor validates normalized relative paths and the native path/source-root relationship before handling every manifest entry.

localRemediations.title: Open planned files without following replacement links
localRemediations.change: Regular files are opened with no-follow/reparse-point semantics and checked against the planned metadata and platform identity.

localRemediations.title: Meet WCAG contrast and progress naming requirements
localRemediations.change: Light/dark semantic colors now meet AA contrast and the aggregate progressbar has an accessible name.

residualRisks: A same-user process can still race replacement of the output directory itself; eliminating that ambient path authority requires directory-handle APIs on every platform.
Foldry preserves symlink targets in archives. A downstream extractor must enforce its own destination containment policy.
Windows locked-file, long-path, and network-drive behavior and macOS packaging behavior still require execution on those operating systems.
openQuestions: Who will execute and sign off the Windows and macOS manual smoke matrix before release?
